data.title: Multi-Operator Behavioral Shift — Timezone and Communication Anomaly
data.description: Detects behavioral patterns suggesting multiple operators are sharing a single employee identity. Indicators include login activity spanning incompatible timezones within a single day, significant shifts in communication style or vocabulary between time windows, and device fingerprint changes that correlate with timezone transitions. DPRK IT workers often operate in shifts from different locations using the same stolen identity.
falsepositives: Employees who travel frequently across timezone boundaries
Employees using multiple devices across home and office locations
